'''Skinklet''' is a [[Water]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Skinkoon]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Skinklet tries so hard to avoid everyone, Tatari and Zobos alike. Still, hiding doesn't always work... especially when blending into a seat cushion and getting sat on."

Skinklet is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, bright cyan lizard with purple spots on its back, tail, and feet. It has large, bulging eyes with blue irises and eyelids.

Skinklet's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] variant changes its purple spots to pink and reddish-purple instead.

== Evolution Trial ==
Skinklet's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Skinkoon]] you need to complete the following task:
* Purchase any 5 buildings. Give Skinklet a hiding spot!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Skinklet! This is a battlefield! Where are you hiding?' - A Zobo incoherently hollers"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Although capable of blending in with surroundings, Skinklet seldom uses this talent, deeming nothing worthy of notice."
